tara_pm: Quick plan check: filling Onramp pilot slots. Target 8-12 partners across e-comm, finserv, internal platform, plus 1 on-prem edge case. Who has seats and gating notes?

leo_eng: Infra can offer 3 seats (includes low-latency routing tests). Two internal teams are candidates.

mason_prodops: We can commit 2 enterprise seats but they need ATO; confirm if Full Private or VPC only.

sophie_research: Proposal for feedback: intake survey -> 1-week trial -> 30m interview -> short NPS. Suggest 2-week cadence for each cohort.

emily_cs: CS asks for 1 concierge per org month 1 and clear success criteria in the invite.

tara_pm: Draft success criteria: integration in <2w, latency p50 <200ms on hosted routes, avg rating >=4/5, <=2 infra escalations in 30d.

leo_eng: Note: latency depends on model size; offer quantized variants for larger models.

mason_prodops: Private on-prem allowed only with SOW and infra lead sign-off. I'll craft a short ATO checklist.

sophie_research: Need minimal telemetry tied to partner id (counts, latencies, errors) — check PII constraints.

beta-coordinator-bot: Recruitment sheet: 4 open slots, 2 pending legal, 1 EU flag.

tara_pm: Scope rule: no bespoke runtime changes during pilot; only standard deployment options. Exceptions route to commercial.

emily_cs: Add opt-out for logs retention >30d in invite copy.

tara_pm: Timeline: invites Tue, onboarding start +2w buffer, 4-week pilot, 1-week internal review.

Actions: leo_eng confirm EU infra by EOD Fri; mason draft ATO by Thu; sophie prepare intake survey + rubric by Mon; emily draft invite + checklist by Mon; tara send invites Tue.

emily_cs: :thumbsup:

sophie_research: On it.

tara_pm: I'll post invite draft here when ready.
